embeds.title: 🌊 HydroTwin Alert — Pleven Oblast
embeds.description:
**Flood watch in effect — elevated risk over the next 24 hours.**

Recent observations show:
• River levels have risen **0.8 m** above the seasonal baseline in the past 3 days
• Ground saturation is high at **89%** — soils cannot absorb much more water
• A further **35 mm of rain** is forecast within the next 24 hours

_Pre-position pumps along the Vit and Osam, brief downstream villages, review evacuation routes for low-lying districts._
